rdf:Description.dc:title: Baseball Tournament
rdf:Description.dc:description: The Philadelphia Athletics Baseball Club played the Washington Nationals Baseball Club on the Ellipse, just south of the White House, in a special game on August 28, 1865. Thousands of locals, including President Andrew Johnson and his family, paid the $1 fee to sit in the newly constructed stands and watch the game. The Nationals were defeated 85-12.
